settings.text: 99.9% pure copper, lab-tested after every manufacturing batch
Hand-hammered exterior that increases contact area with water
Zero plastic and zero microplastic risk

settings.heading: Microplastics accumulate. Your bottle may be part of the load.
settings.body: Studies suggest the average person has already ingested a significant amount of microplastics through drinking water alone. These particles do not simply pass through; they can accumulate. Every time you drink from a plastic bottle, you may be adding to that load. Switching to a pure copper vessel removes one daily source of microplastic exposure. You are not performing a dramatic “detox.” You are simply stopping the addition.

settings.heading: Plastic and even some metals are not neutral.
settings.body: Plastic can release BPA, phthalates, and other compounds into water, especially when bottles sit in heat or are reused for long periods. Stainless steel is more stable, yet microscopic scratches become places where bacteria thrive. Aluminum often relies on an inner lining that can degrade. Pure copper does not leach plastic compounds. Its surface has natural antimicrobial properties that have been studied for decades. The difference is not theoretical — it is material science.

settings.heading: Copper has been used for water storage for centuries.
settings.body: Tamra Jal — water stored in copper — is not a social-media invention. Families across the Indian subcontinent have kept water in copper vessels for generations. The practice is part of a broader understanding that the vessel matters as much as the water itself. Neera simply brings that tradition into a modern, leak-proof, hand-hammered form that fits real life: car cup holders, travel, and daily desks.

settings.heading: A naturally antimicrobial surface.
settings.body: Copper is one of only a handful of materials with inherent antimicrobial properties. Hospitals have installed copper surfaces for this reason. When water rests inside a pure copper bottle, it sits against a surface that actively discourages many common bacteria. Plastic and scratched steel do not offer the same environment. This is not a marketing slogan — it is a documented characteristic of the metal.

settings.heading: It turns hydration into a ritual.
settings.body: Fill the bottle in the evening. Let it rest overnight. Drink in the morning. That simple sequence transforms something automatic into something intentional. Many Neera owners tell us the ritual itself changes how they relate to water. It is no longer just another bottle on the desk — it is a quiet daily practice.

settings.heading: Hand-hammered means more contact area.
settings.body: Machine-smooth copper is beautiful. Hand-hammered copper is functional. Each strike creates micro-indentations that increase the surface area in contact with the water. The texture is not decoration alone — it is part of how the vessel works. No two Neera bottles are identical. That irregularity is the point.

settings.heading: Lab-tested purity you can verify.
settings.body: The market is full of bottles that look like copper and are not. Some are copper-plated aluminum. Some contain mixed metals. Every batch of Neera bottles is tested after manufacturing for material purity. We provide access to the Certificate of Authenticity so you can see the verification yourself. Real copper is non-magnetic. The hand-hammered pattern is irregular. The certificate is available. These are the simple checks that matter.

settings.heading: Designed for real life, not just the shelf.
settings.body: 34 ounces — enough for a full day of intentional sipping. Leak-proof threaded cap that opens and closes with a single twist. Dimensions that fit most standard U.S. car cup holders and kitchen cabinets. Weight that feels solid without being heavy. Every bottle ships with a Copper Care Brush and a Travel Sleeve. This is not a decorative object. It is built to be used every day.

settings.heading: Better for the planet — and for the bottles that come after yours.
settings.body: One copper bottle replaces hundreds of single-use plastic bottles over its lifetime. Pure copper does not degrade the way plastic does. With simple care it can serve for decades and, in many families, become something that is passed on. Choosing Neera is not another purchase in a cycle of replacements. It is a decision to step out of that cycle.

settings.heading: The Neera promise: a small brand that takes every order seriously.
settings.body: We are not a giant corporation. We are a small team that built Neera around one idea: everyday drinkware should be made with natural materials, real craftsmanship, and integrity. If something is not right with your order, reach out. We will make it right — no run-around, no script. Free shipping on every order. Use code NEERA10 for an extra 10% off. Buy more and save up to 15%. You are not only buying a bottle. You are supporting a way of making things that still cares about the person on the other end.

settings.text: In the evening, fill the bottle with clean, filtered, room-temperature or cool water.
Let it rest for 6–8 hours, or overnight.
In the morning, drink. Throughout the day you can refill and use it as you would any water bottle.
Once a week, or whenever you notice tarnish, clean with lemon and salt or mild soap and the included soft brush. Rinse thoroughly.

settings.question: Is it safe to drink from every day?
settings.answer: Yes. The Neera bottle is made from pure, food-grade copper and is safe for everyday use as drinkware. Use with clean, filtered, room-temperature or cool water. Follow the simple care instructions. These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA and are not intended as medical claims.
